# Q Billiards Arena | Pool Hall and Snooker in Houston

> Q Billiards Arena is a large billiards and snooker venue in Houston, Texas. The club offers American pool, standard and heated snooker, Chinese 9-ball, carom billiards, weekly tournaments, poker room rentals, food, drinks, and late-night entertainment.

## Business Information

- Business name: Q Billiards Arena
- Address: 10500 W Belfort Ave, Unit 200, Houston, TX 77031
- Phone: 713-498-8813
- Website: https://www.qbilliardshtx.com
- Blog: https://blog.qbilliardshtx.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/qbilliards_htx
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@qbilliards_htx

## Hours

- Sunday through Thursday: 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM
- Friday and Saturday: 5:00 PM to 4:00 AM

## Games and Table Rates

- American Pool, 7-foot tables: $10 per hour
- American Pool, 9-foot tables: $15 per hour
- Standard Snooker: $15 per hour
- Heated Snooker: $20 per hour
- Chinese 9-Ball: $15 per hour
- Carom and Three-Cushion Billiards: $15 per hour

## Tournaments and Events

Q Billiards Arena hosts recurring pool and snooker tournaments in Houston.

- Pool tournaments: Tuesdays and Fridays at 9:00 PM
- One Red Snooker tournament: Thursdays
- Chinese 9-ball tournaments: announced through the club website and social media
- Additional special events and tournaments are announced regularly

## Food and Drinks

The venue offers burgers, fried chicken, snacks, chai, coffee, cold drinks, lassi, mojitos, and other refreshments. Current menu items and prices are available at:

https://www.qbilliardshtx.com/menu/

## Promotions

Q Billiards Arena periodically offers free American pool with an equal qualifying purchase. Promotion requirements and participating tables should be confirmed with club staff.
